implementation.name: NES (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 60 HDL source files (27 systemverilog, 5 verilog, 28 vhdl) alongside 65 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the NES and the Famicom, which MAME keeps as separate parents, giving machine_id nes and machine_id famicom. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. license_id omitted: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/NES_MiSTer/blob/master/COPYING is the verbatim GNU GPL version 3 text, but neither only-this-version nor any-later-version is stated there or in the HDL headers read (NES.sv), and GPL's version scope comes from the grant, not the licence text. GPL-3.0-only and GPL-3.0-or-later are both consistent with what the repository actually says. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 60 source files (27 systemverilog, 5 verilog, 28 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
